Verified administrators with the existing admin:ads.view permission can list and read safe advertising financial-review projections and bounded not-realized ledger events. The runtime now reads persisted advertising request, quote, payment-proof, and schedule records through a redacting source adapter; strict filters, route authentication, safe errors, OpenAPI, Postman, and API inventory are synchronized.

sourceEvidence: agent_pack/01_product/BUSINESS_RULES.md (payment proof is not bank verification; no realized-revenue claim)
scopeNotes: This is an authorized Backend truth repair directly required by the ADM-38 financial-review screen in frontend_070; app/server and API-artifact wiring are explicitly included integration changes.
The existing admin:ads.view permission is reused; no new financial permission, settlement operation, bank-verification claim, or realized-revenue field was introduced.
The source adapter projects only safe fields and excludes payment-proof storage keys, private URLs, credentials, internal notes, and administrator-only audit data.
knownGaps: Live MongoDB persistence verification was not run because no isolated non-production replica-set topology was configured; deterministic source/service and HTTP tests cover the boundary locally.
The routes are read-only review projections and do not perform financial settlement, collection, or approval beyond exposing existing payment-proof status.
